date.description: Default today; a future date is rejected

restSeconds.description: Seconds until endDateTime while start <= now < end, otherwise null (BR-12)

Settings.description: Profile and preferences of the single user (FR-10.2, Q3)

tags.description: Lower case (Q1), alphabetical; empty when the task has no tags
Each tag is trimmed first, then must be 1-30 characters (BR-T1); checked by the server, error field `tags`

get.summary: App time zone and the server's current time

delete.summary: Delete the habit and its completions permanently (BR-14)

post.summary: Record a completion for a date (default today); one per habit and date (BR-7)

get.summary: Cards with their milestones and notes, newest first

delete.summary: Delete the card, its milestones and notes permanently (BR-14)

put.summary: Edit title/target date and set done or not done

parameters.description: active = NOT_STARTED or IN_PROGRESS (priorityOrder asc, then start asc); completed = COMPLETED (end desc); all = active then completed
parameters.name: group

get.summary: Plans with computed status, progress and rest time

delete.summary: Delete the plan and its items; referenced sources are unchanged (BR-14)

put.summary: Edit title, estimated duration, start/end and priority order (items are unchanged)
Mark a plan item done or not done; a TASK item marked done also completes the task; un-ticking and HABIT/LEARNING_RESOURCE items change no source (BR-13, Q1)

parameters.description: Only tasks that have this tag (whole tag, ignoring case, spaces around it ignored); blank = no tag filter (FR-004); a value no task has gives an empty list
parameters.name: tag

get.summary: List tasks (search, filters incl. tag, sort; archived excluded by default, BR-4)
Tasks due before today, not Done, not archived (FR-01.7)

put.summary: Replace the editable fields (status DONE sets completedAt, leaving DONE clears it)

delete.summary: Remove one tag, matched ignoring case (FR-005). A tag the task doesn't have is a no-op (Q3).

post.summary: Add tags (FR-001). Trimmed, case-insensitive (BR-T2); a tag already on the task is kept once (Q2). All or nothing: an invalid tag or more than 10 tags in total rejects the whole request and leaves the tags unchanged (BR-T1, BR-T3).
